name: Document workflow record (levels + escalation)
observed_behavior: Two admin pages: a workflows table (ID, Name, Module, Levels 2-6, Escalation 12/24/36/48 hours, Active Yes/No) with Add/Edit modals (Workflow ID*, Module* select HR/Finance/Legal, Name*, Levels, Escalation, Active) and delete confirmation; and an approvals catalog table (ID, Module, Name, Description, Status) with module filter chips and an Add/Edit Record modal (ID*, Module*, Name*, Status* Active/Inactive, Description). Sample approval use cases: expense, PO by value, leave, discount >10%, timesheet, asset disposal, policy, access, contract, audit exception.
unverified_behavior: Any routing, condition evaluation, approver assignment, notification, SLA timing or execution. No builder, triggers, conditions or logs exist in the pages.
business_problem: Approvals are configured inconsistently per module with no single register.
jobs_to_be_done: Register an approval workflow for a module; see its level count and escalation time; activate/deactivate it.
navigation_path: Settings > Document Workflows; Settings > Workflow & Approvals
actions: Add, Edit, Delete (confirm), Search, Sort, Print, Export, paginate (10/25/50/100)
input_fields: Workflow ID, Module, Name, Levels, Escalation, Active / ID, Module, Name, Status, Description
outputs: Saved workflow record in the table
validations: ID, Module, Name required (asterisk-marked in the source form)
data_entities: Workflow {id, module, name, levels, escalation_hours, active}; ApprovalRecord {id, module, name, description, status}
automation_candidates: This record is the seed of the proposed automation engine (automation-lab/)
edge_cases: Duplicate IDs; levels semantics undefined in source; escalation without a calendar
security_privacy: Rule records may encode approval policy — restrict edit rights; audit changes
responsive_accessibility: Modal CRUD pattern is responsive-neutral; keyboard behaviour NOT_VERIFIED
implementation_complexity: Low (as observed) / High (as a real engine)
benefit_hypothesis: A single register of approval workflows reduces shadow processes.
acceptance_criteria: Given an admin, when they create a workflow with module+levels+escalation, then it appears in the table with an Active flag and can be deactivated without deletion.
test_cases: Deactivate hides the workflow from new documents (proposed semantics — not source behaviour)
